features.label: Features overview
features.tagline: Key capabilities · aligned with the current in-app manual
features.intro: WinProx is one Facility web app: issues come in, become tasks, and are handled by teams. Time (punch clock) is optional.
features.source: Sources: Manual (Getting started + chapters) and FAQ in the app.
features.footer_right: See also: Technical fact sheet (hosting, GDPR, security)

left.title: No app required
left.body: Everything runs in the browser. Back office is desktop-first; field and QR portals are mobile-first. No App Store, no install.

left.title: QR portals
left.body: Unit QR: report issues, plus an optional unit check (quick OK or Not OK). Clock Point QR: sign in (name + icon) and team tasks; clock in/out only with Time (punch clock). Location QR. Printable as sticker sheet (Avery) or full-page A6/A5/A4. Dynamic QRs that can be linked to a unit later. Invalid or expired QR codes show a short error with a button to the homepage.

left.title: Unit checks
left.body: Quickly confirm a unit is fine — for example after a security round, cleaning check or technical inspection. On the unit QR you tap OK or Not OK; OK needs no separate issue. Optionally tick a checklist first. Not OK still works alongside the normal report flow.

left.title: Inspection rounds
left.body: Recurring issue with a fixed route of units (stops), including across locations. Plan via Issues → Plan inspection round (stops, interval and team in one step) or optionally via the issue wizard. Work → Inspection rounds opens the same list filtered to rounds. Only units with unit checks appear in the stop list; other units are hidden. One task per cycle; at each stop Unit check OK, Not OK (with issue; description prefilled), or skip with reason. Done when all stops for that cycle are handled.

left.title: Branding & QR
left.body: Organisation logo and portal background; unit photos and a background photo per unit. Avery or A6/A5/A4 sticker formats under Settings — print-ready.

left.title: Issues
left.body: Via unit QR, manually in admin, or (with IoT) a sensor alarm. Filters, approval of QR reports, recurring maintenance (pause or close). Optional: required contact details and/or email confirmation for anonymous QR reporters (category and unit; confirmation holds the report until the email link). On public QR pages visible only after approval; admin sees everything immediately. In admin a Reporter confirmed pill appears when the QR reporter confirmed the email link.

left.title: Photos
left.body: Up to 4 photos per issue or completion (resized on the device before upload). Also: up to 4 unit photos and a background photo per unit for the QR portal. Visible immediately in the back office; reporter photos on the public portal only after approval.

left.title: GPS
left.body: Per category: “Allow GPS location” for mobile units (vehicle, machine, …). Capture location via the portal; history in the back office, open in Maps.

left.title: ESG & Compliance
left.body: ESG = Environmental, Social & Governance: readings for environment, safety and compliance (energy, inspections, …). Optional module on WinProx Corporate: indicators, measurements and follow-up tasks for recurring checks. Record via portal, back office or API.

left.title: AI translation
left.body: After approval, texts are queued for translation (issues, tasks, documents, announcements, …). WinProx fills the other languages periodically via local AI (no external AI cloud), typically daily — with no guaranteed turnaround. Organisation admins can correct translations manually; there is no per-organisation on/off switch.

right.title: Multi-tenant
right.body: Each organisation has its own environment with limits per plan (WinProx 10/50/100 + Corporate).

right.title: Facility
right.body: Locations, units, categories, teams and workers (internal or external). Under Places: Categories, Locations and Units (tenant-wide). Bulk/CSV import, dashboard, documents and announcements on the portal. Enable unit checks per category and unit; manage checklists under People → Teams — shared or per team. New organisations can load a starter template on the dashboard (hotel, hospital, industry or municipality) with sample teams, categories, a location and units — names in every language. You can rename everything later; once issues exist, units can only be deactivated.

right.title: Tasks
right.body: One issue → one or more tasks, each for one team. Priority, due date, notes. Follow-up via the Tasks list and QR on the floor.

right.title: Briefing
right.body: Printable report of open tasks for the selected day, grouped by team. Available from Dashboard, Tasks and Calendar — useful at shift start.

right.title: Calendar
right.body: Month, week and day views of tasks, issues and reservations. From the calendar you can also print the briefing for that day.

right.title: Time
right.body: Time is an optional punch clock: clock in/out, breaks, presence and timesheets. Clock Point remains the sign-in QR (name + icon, task list) even without Time. Time is included in the trial. On WinProx it is optional: monthly add-on on the yearly invoice.

right.title: Reservations
right.body: For shared resources with a time slot (room, vehicle, key). Category Reservable + Allow reservations per unit (off by default). Guest books via unit QR (hold + email confirmation). Manage via Reservations menu and calendar.

right.title: IoT Connect
right.body: Sensor gateways send events; alarms become an approved issue + task. Measurements → ESG. WinProx Corporate only. Gateway token (also without the full REST API).

right.title: API & webhooks
right.body: REST API tokens and outbound webhooks (HMAC) under Settings. Connect issues, tasks, unit checks, ESG, … IoT ingest via a separate gateway token. See also the API & Webhooks sheet and the technical fact sheet.

full.title: Roles
full.body: Admin — full control + subscription · Employee — day-to-day follow-up (no billing/accounts) · Worker — field work via Clock Point + unit QR, without WinProx login · Team leader — release icons and coordinate via the Clock Point portal.

full.title: Back-office login
full.body: Admins and employees sign in with email + password, or via **Sign in with Microsoft** (Microsoft Entra). Only existing WinProx accounts; the Microsoft email must match. Workers stay on Clock Point QR (name + icon), without Microsoft sign-in. Connecting other software uses API tokens, not this login.

technical.label: Technical fact sheet
technical.tagline: Facility issues: QR → tasks → completion · SaaS for operational teams
technical.intro: Overview for IT / security. WinProx is a multi-tenant web application (Laravel + MySQL) where each customer organisation has its own isolated environment.
technical.footer_left: WinProx · info@winprox.app · Product overview, not legal advice or an SLA.
technical.footer_right: Questions? We are happy to walk through the DPA, subprocessors and integrations.

left.title: Hosting
items: Production on **Linux** (EU), at **Cloud86**.
Access via **HTTPS** (encrypted connection, TLS).
Stack: PHP 8.2+, Laravel 12, Livewire, MySQL, Vite frontend.
Email via SMTP in the EU; payments optional via Stripe.

left.title: Backups
items: Automatic **daily** backups via Cloud86 (files + database), retained for **7 days**.
**RPO ≈ 24 hours**: in the worst case you lose data since the last nightly backup (Recovery Point Objective = max. acceptable data loss).
**RTO: best effort, typically within 1 business day** (Recovery Time Objective = time until the service is available again after restore).
On full organisation deletion: separate technical SQL snapshot **without media**, max. **30 days** (not the same as a disaster-recovery backup).

left.title: Database
items: **MySQL**, relational model per tenant.
Strict **tenant isolation**: every query/API call stays within the organisation.
No shared visibility between customers.

left.title: Permissions
items: **Admin**: everything (users, company, subscription, teams).
**Employee**: operational (issues, tasks, locations) — no account/billing management.
**Worker / team leader**: complete tasks via the field portal; team leaders can release icons.
Every action is checked: you only get what your role allows (**least privilege**). API keys get separate permissions — e.g. “read issues” without access to everything.

left.title: API
items: **REST API v1** (fixed URLs + HTTP methods) with **JSON** responses (standard data format). Documentation in-app + docs.
Incl. issues, tasks, locations, units (incl. external ID), teams, workers, unit checks (also inbound via external unit ID), ESG, translations.
Available on **Corporate** (trial on request).
IoT ingest separately via gateway token (Corporate).

right.title: GDPR
items: **Customer = controller**; WinProx = **processor**.
Framework: EU GDPR + Belgian Act of 30 July 2018.
Data Processing Agreement (DPA) and subprocessor list available.
Data export (account), self-service organisation deletion, retention periods documented.

Data stays in the **EU** (hosting/email). Stripe EU/US when paying. With **Sign in with Microsoft**, the user is sent to Microsoft Entra ID (Microsoft, EU/US); WinProx receives email (and possibly name) to match the existing account.

Optional email confirmation for QR reports: temporary draft storage until the link; unverified drafts are deleted automatically (typically 60 minutes, including photos). The confirmation mail is only sent to a valid address that is not marked undeliverable (bounce). Unsubscribing from marketing mail does not block this confirmation. No user account.

right.title: Availability
items: Available 24/7 as SaaS (browser + QR portals).
Planned maintenance preferably outside business hours, with notice where possible.
Formal uptime SLA: available contractually on request.

right.title: Authentication
items: Back office: email + password (stored hashed), sessions.

Self-service sign-up requires **email verification**: the account only works after clicking the link in the confirmation mail. The confirmation mail is only sent to a valid address that is not marked undeliverable (bounce). Unsubscribing from marketing mail does not block this confirmation. Unverified sign-ups are automatically and completely deleted after 7 days.

**SSO** (one work login via Microsoft Entra): for admins and employees on desktop (**Sign in with Microsoft**). Only existing WinProx accounts (email must match the Microsoft account); email + password still works. No automatic new accounts. Workers stay on Clock Point QR (name + icon). Connecting other software (Ultimo, IWMS, …) uses API tokens, not SSO.
API: personal **access key** (Bearer token via Laravel Sanctum). Revocable; with scopes = which actions the key may perform.
Workers: **no email login** — Clock Point QR + name + personal icon.
Reporters: public QR portal without an account. Optional mailbox proof (category and unit): no login; the issue is created only after the link in the mail.

right.title: Security
items: HTTPS; hashed passwords; revocable API tokens.
**CSRF protection**: prevents another website from secretly performing actions as a logged-in user.
Tenant scoping; audit/activity logs.
Webhooks with **HMAC-SHA256** signature (proof the message comes from WinProx).
API: max. **60 requests/minute** per token.
Support access: exceptional, read-only by default.

right.title: Webhooks
items: Outbound HTTP POST on events (incl. issue/task status, unit check, ESG, GPS).
Configured under Settings → API; secret for verification.
Automatic retries on failure (several attempts with increasing delay).
Same plan requirement as API (Corporate).
With optional email confirmation, the **issue created** event fires only after the link, not when the form is submitted on the portal.

full.title: Spam & abuse (limits)
items: **Public QR issues** (per device/IP, per unit): max. **1 issue per 3 minutes**; max. **5 issues per 30 minutes** on the same unit; max. **20 issues per hour** across all units of the same organisation. (Signed-in workers are exempt.)
**Worker sign-in (icon)**: after **2 wrong icon choices** the worker is locked until a team leader or admin releases them.
**Back-office login** (email/password): passwords hashed; no separate app rate limit on failed logins (can be strengthened via infra/contract).

Extra: QR issues on the public portal stay **invisible until approval**. Optional email confirmation (category and unit) holds the report until the email link; existing QR limits count at submit. API has its own rate limit (60/min).

full.title: AI (Artificial Intelligence)
items: After approval, operational texts (issues, tasks, units, announcements, …) are queued for AI translation.
Runs on a **local Ollama instance** — no ChatGPT / external AI cloud for this feature.
WinProx runs translations **periodically** (typically daily), **with no guaranteed turnaround**. Organisation admins can **correct translations manually**. No per-organisation on/off switch.
No generative “AI assistant” that autonomously decides customer processes — translation is support, not decision-making.

api_webhooks.label: API & Webhooks
api_webhooks.tagline: Integrate WinProx with your existing software via APIs and webhooks.
api_webhooks.highlight: WinProx is not a replacement for existing IWMS or ERP systems. Thanks to APIs and webhooks, WinProx works alongside them.
api_webhooks.intro: WinProx is built so other software can use the same data, issues, tasks and unit checks as WinProx itself. Manage and read docs under Settings → API. Desktop **Sign in with Microsoft** is not an API integration: other software uses tokens, not SSO.
api_webhooks.footer_right: See also: Features overview · Technical fact sheet

left.title: Why APIs and webhooks?
left.body: With the API and webhooks, WinProx can work with existing software. For example:
items: automatically forward an issue to your IWMS, CMMS or ERP;
forward a unit check (OK/Not OK) to your external facility software;
receive a unit check from your external facility software (via external unit ID);
synchronise tasks with an ERP system;
show data in Power BI;
let IoT sensors create issues automatically;
connect to your own software or Microsoft Power Automate.
left.emphasis: Your central system (IWMS, ERP, BI) stays in the lead — WinProx complements it on the shop floor.

rows: Your system asks WinProx for something
WinProx sends a message to your system

left.title: What this is not
items: Not every action is available via the API. Some parts are intentionally read-only or support only specific actions. That keeps integrations safe and manageable.
You manage webhooks in the app, not via the API.
A generic inbound webhook endpoint for arbitrary external systems is not a product feature yet (IoT and Stripe have their own paths).
API & outbound webhooks: Corporate (trial API on request).

right.title: REST API
right.body: The API lets other software safely retrieve data or perform actions inside WinProx. Communication uses standard REST endpoints and JSON.
items: **Access:** personal access token (Bearer). Revocable. Per token you choose permissions (scopes), e.g. read issues only.
**Organisation boundary:** each token belongs to one organisation; you never see another customer’s data.
**Safety:** request rate limit per minute. Optional Idempotency-Key so a repeated request does not create a duplicate action.
**IoT separately:** sensors use a gateway token (Corporate), not the same API token.

rows: Issues, Tasks, Locations, Units, Teams, Workers, Unit checks

right.title: Outbound webhooks
right.body: WinProx sends an HTTP POST to a URL you provide whenever something happens.
items: **Setup:** Settings → API → Webhooks (URL + which events). The secret is shown once — store it safely.
**Proof of origin:** each message has an HMAC signature (verifiable with your secret).
**Reliability:** if delivery fails, WinProx retries (with increasing delay). Deliveries appear in a log.

**Other events include:** issue created / approved / status changed · task created / started / completed · Time · GPS · ESG · reservations · test button · unit check recorded. With email confirmation: **issue created** only after the link.
right.emphasis: Example: a worker completes a task. WinProx automatically sends a webhook to your external system (IWMS, CMMS or ERP) so a work order can be updated immediately.

full.title: Ready for integration
full.body: WinProx is designed to work alongside existing systems. Suitable for integration with, among others:
items: IWMS / facility management
CMMS / maintenance systems
ERP
Microsoft Power Automate
Power BI
Custom software
IoT platforms
full.emphasis: Have an existing IT landscape? We are happy to explore how WinProx fits. Contact: info@winprox.app · Documentation: Settings → API → Docs
